intro: Cinq 1500 Console is designed to create moments of pause within everyday spaces. With its layered storage and understated detailing, it brings quiet sophistication to entryways, hallways, and bedrooms.

features.title: Minimal modern styling for versatile placement
features.text: The console’s restrained silhouette and balanced proportions allow it to settle effortlessly into varied spaces, without overpowering the surroundings. Its soft, contemporary neutral palette creates a composed backdrop that pairs seamlessly with both muted interiors and statement decor elements.

features.title: Tubular steel structure for light architectural character
features.text: The slender tubular steel frame introduces a refined linear aesthetic while providing dependable support and long-term durability.

features.title: Integrated storage for everyday essentials
features.text: Two drawers discreetly organise keys, accessories, documents, and daily-use belongings, helping maintain a neat and uncluttered environment. Additionally, the open storage section allows books, decor accents, and collectibles to be displayed with ease, adding personality and warmth to the space.

features.title: Elevated profile for airy spatial balance
features.text: Raised from the ground, the console maintains visual openness and allows easy cleaning beneath, making interiors feel lighter and more spacious.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
